summary.text: Tiffany Alston is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 24 who is running for the Maryland State Senate in District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an attorney and business owner who previously served in the House from 2011 to 2013 and returned in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Tiffany Alston graduated from Central High School in Capitol Heights, Maryland, and earned a B.A. in criminology and criminal justice from the University of Maryland, College Park.
She received a J.D. from the University of the District of Columbia David A. Clarke School of Law in 2002.

Alston served as chief of staff of the Division of Correction in the Maryland Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services from 2004 to 2005 and has operated the Alston Law Office since 2004.
Alston served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2011 to 2013 and assumed office again on January 11, 2023.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2018 run for the Maryland State Senate in District 24, which she lost in the primary.
She is not seeking re-election to the House in 2026, and she advanced from the Democratic primary for the Senate seat on June 23, 2026.
According to the General Assembly website, she serves on the Health Committee.
